title: Close false-assurance defects across skills gate, MCP toolkit, CLI, and NEXUS
outcome: No AI SAFE2 component reports safe, compliant, or blocked when the four-area battery shows otherwise.
acceptance_conditions: Four-area battery: 0 FAIL and 0 NOT_RUN on the branch under the same harness that records main's failures.
Every fixed defect has a regression test that fails on main and passes on the branch.
Local CI mirror (gates.sh) passes every gate at the final revision.
Hosted CI on PR #393 passes at the final revision with no new CodeQL alerts.
Owner decisions D1-D4 are recorded and D1, D3 implemented; D4 interim floor in place and follow-up scoped.
trust_boundaries: MCP client to untrusted MCP server (remote scoring, wrap-stdio, wrap-proxy)
Agent tool call to NEXUS Guardian and OPA policy decision point
Untrusted skill package to model context (skill trust gate)
CI runner to downloaded OPA and gitleaks binaries (checksum-verified)
assumptions: OPA 0.65.0 remains the docker-compose pin; 1.x support is additive.
Battery results are self-assessment by the authoring agent, not independent validation.
unknowns: Live docker compose up was not exercised (no Docker daemon in the assessment environment).
Greptile review has not run on this PR.

design.summary: One commit per module; each defect gets a red-on-main regression test; hostile fixtures inert in tree; evidence frozen in docs/assessments/2026-10-06-false-assurance.

testing.rationale: Every fix is preceded by a test observed failing on main (83de4a8).
